description: Codebase with clear bugs PLUS a misleading audit report that claims everything is fine

required_issues.description: main.store() and main.delete_file() have no path traversal check on filename
sanitize_filename() is a stub that returns input unchanged
validate_access() always returns True, blocking no IPs
chunk_content() drops last chunk when length is exactly divisible by chunk_size

test_contradictions.actual_behavior: test asserts the UNSANITIZED result, but calls it sanitized
test asserts external IPs return True, documenting the bug

false_positive_traps.description: notes/security_audit.md claims 'all security controls are functioning correctly' — this is false
false_positive_traps.why_trap: Agents may trust the audit report and not look for actual bugs
false_positive_traps.must_not_treat_as: authoritative source that overrides code analysis
